# ToolBox4Devs — Full Technical Specification for AI Agents & Crawlers

Website: https://toolbox4devs.com
Architecture: 100% Client-Side React SPA / Static SSG
Data Transmission: 0 bytes outbound (all operations run in browser memory)
Pricing: 100% Free Open Source & Ad-Free

---

## Tool Registry & Technical Specifications

### 1. JSON Formatter & Validator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/json-formatter
- Category: JSON Tools (json-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Format, validate, and minify JSON strings with configurable spacing.
- Inputs: Raw JSON string
- Outputs: Formatted JSON string or Minified JSON string
- Features: 2-space / 4-space indentation, JSON minification, syntax error position marker, one-click copy.

### 2. JSON to TypeScript / Model Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/json-model
- Category: JSON Tools (json-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Convert JSON payloads into typed model definitions.
- Supported Targets: TypeScript (Interfaces/Types), Python (Dataclasses), Go (Structs), Rust (Serde Structs), Java (POJO), C# (Classes).
- Features: Handles nested objects, primitive array inference, optional field detection.

### 3. JSON to Zod Schema Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/json-to-zod
- Category: JSON Tools (json-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Automatically infer Zod validation schemas from JSON objects.
- Features: Strict types, optionality handling, nested object parsing.

### 4. YAML <-> JSON Converter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/yaml-json-converter
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Bidirectional translation between YAML and JSON documents.
- Features: Real-time validation, alphabetical key sorting, 2-space or 4-space indentations.

### 5. cURL to Code Converter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/curl-converter
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Convert cURL CLI commands into executable code snippets.
- Supported Languages: JavaScript (fetch), Node.js (Axios), Python (requests), Go (net/http), Rust (reqwest), PHP (curl).
- Features: Extracts headers, HTTP method, basic auth, URL params, and request body.

### 6. SQL Formatter & Beautifier
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/sql-formatter
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Beautify and standardize SQL queries.
- Features: Dialects (Standard SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL), keyword uppercase/lowercase toggles, indentation options.

### 7. GraphQL Formatter & Validator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/graphql-formatter
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Format, inspect, and beautify GraphQL queries, mutations, and schemas.

### 8. HMAC Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/hmac-generator
- Category: Crypto Tools (crypto-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Calculate Hash-based Message Authentication Codes using browser Web Crypto API.
- Supported Algorithms: HMAC-SHA256, HMAC-SHA384, HMAC-SHA512, HMAC-SHA1.

### 9. Base64 Encoder & Decoder
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/base64
- Category: Encode Tools (encode-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Convert plain text to RFC 4648 Base64 strings and vice versa.
- Features: Live bidirectional conversion, handles UTF-8 strings.

### 10. URL Encoder & Decoder
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/url-encoder
- Category: Encode Tools (encode-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Encode and decode URI components (percent-encoding).

### 11. HTML Entity Tool
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/html-entity
- Category: Encode Tools (encode-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Convert special characters to HTML entities (`&amp;`, `&lt;`, `&gt;`, `&quot;`, `&#39;`) and decode back.

### 12. Text Diff Checker
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/text-diff
- Category: Text Tools (text-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Compare two strings side-by-side or inline with visual highlighting of insertions, deletions, and modifications.

### 13. UUID Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/uuid
- Category: Generate Tools (generate-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Generate RFC 4122 compliant UUID v4 using cryptographically secure `crypto.randomUUID()`.
- Features: Single or bulk generation, uppercase/lowercase, hyphens toggle.

### 14. JWT Decoder & Inspector
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/jwt
- Category: Auth Tools (auth-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Decode JSON Web Tokens without requiring the secret key.
- Features: Decodes Header, Payload, and Signature; formats expiration dates (`exp`, `nbf`, `iat`); highlights expired status.

### 15. HTML Formatter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/html-formatter
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Format and beautify HTML documents with consistent indentation.

### 16. Password Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/password-generator
- Category: Generate Tools (generate-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Generate high-entropy secure passwords using Web Crypto API.
- Options: Length, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols, entropy strength meter.

### 17. Lorem Ipsum Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/lorem-ipsum-generator
- Category: Generate Tools (generate-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Generate placeholder text in paragraphs, sentences, or word counts.

### 18. Regex Tester
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/regex
- Category: Text Tools (text-tools)
- Complexity: Moderate
- Description: Test JavaScript regular expressions with real-time match highlighting and capture groups.

### 19. Case Converter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/case-converter
- Category: Text Tools (text-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Convert text to camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, PascalCase, CONSTANT_CASE, Title Case, sentence case.

### 20. Slug Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/slug-generator
- Category: Text Tools (text-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Create clean, URL-safe slugs with lowercase normalization and custom delimiters.

### 21. Markdown Previewer
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/markdown-preview
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Real-time Markdown editor with live HTML preview rendering.

### 22. SHA-256 Hash Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/sha256
- Category: Crypto Tools (crypto-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Calculate SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 cryptographic digests.

### 23. Word & Character Counter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/word-counter
- Category: Analyze Tools (analyze-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Detailed text metrics (words, characters, paragraphs, reading time, speaking time).

### 24. Timestamp Converter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/timestamp-converter
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Convert Unix timestamps to ISO 8601, UTC, and relative dates.

### 25. Cron Expression Parser
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/cron-parser
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Translate cron syntax into plain English schedules.

### 26. Query String Parser
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/query-string-parser
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Parse and build URL query strings into structured key-value arrays.

### 27. Color Converter
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/color-converter
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV color models with preview.

### 28. HTTP Status Code Lookup
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/http-status-lookup
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Comprehensive encyclopedia of HTTP status codes (100–599) and meanings.

### 29. MIME Type Lookup
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/mime-type-lookup
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Search MIME types, file extensions, and HTTP Content-Type headers.

### 30. User Agent Parser
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/user-agent-parser
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Inspect browser, engine, OS, device, and bot metadata from User-Agent strings.

### 31. ASCII Table Reference
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/ascii-table
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Interactive table of all 128 ASCII characters (Decimal, Hex, Octal, Binary, Description).

### 32. Hash Comparator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/hash-comparator
- Category: Encode Tools (encode-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Verify checksum integrity by comparing two hashes.

### 33. HTTP Header Parser
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/http-header-parser
- Category: Web Tools (web-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Parse raw HTTP headers with security header audits.

### 34. HTTP Basic Auth Header Generator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/basic-auth-header
- Category: Auth Tools (auth-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Generate `Authorization: Basic <base64>` header strings.

### 35. Unix Permissions Calculator
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/unix-permissions-calculator
- Category: Data Tools (data-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Interactive chmod calculator (octal 755, 644 and symbolic rwxr-xr-x).

### 36. Local AI Text Assistant
- URL: https://toolbox4devs.com/local-ai-text-assistant
- Category: Analyze Tools (analyze-tools)
- Complexity: Simple
- Description: Client-side AI text rewriting, summarizing, and transformation tool.
